offline_replay.scope: Unchanged failed actual pre-step body speeds, raw acceleration, mandatory deceleration and actual brake inputs. No new steering, pose, outcome or tire-force truth is simulated.

independent_clear_postcap_audit.scope: CLOSED per-physics-command causal reconstruction includingfinalcrossing tick. Noactualtire-force or globaldriver safetyguarantee claimed.

independent_clear_floor_audit.scope: One CLOSED clear lap. Recomputes known-route floor from frozen NPZ and PREVIOUS trace pose/speed; coordinator modification proof is separate from an overall tire-force guarantee.
independent_clear_floor_audit.floor_scope_limitation: When the required floor dominates the baseline request, the release-only coordinator bypasses without escalating braking. The proven invariant concerns its shaped/released ticks, not every baseline brake tick or a measured physical friction bound.

independent_clear_steering_report.scope: CLOSED physical steering comparison.50Hz claims only when actual per-tick commands are present.

definitions.total_variation: Sum absolute consecutive recorded command differences; exact at50Hz, lower bound when downsampled.
definitions.highpass: Offline third-order zero-phase1Hz high-pass used for measurement only, never an online filtering proposal.
definitions.steering_acceleration: Finite difference of command rate divided by the mean adjacent interval; unitsrad/s², no measured tire-force claim.
definitions.direction_change: New steering extremum confirmed after opposite excursion>=.005rad, cadence-independent.
definitions.stable_regime: Excludes±.3s around sampled method, geometry or planned-mode changes; does not assert absence of nearby traffic.
definitions.fixed_anchors: 18 predeclared original-reference curvature peaks from prior calibration audit; unreached anchors remain explicitly unobserved.

clear_lap_qualified_scope: Clear lap with shared source; selected zero-cost main and bounded-fixture qualification separately completed.
